product.title: Edinburgh Food & Drink Tour with EatWalk Tours

description.text: EatWalk leads a three-hour food and drink walk through Edinburgh New Town, Edinburgh Old Town, and past John Knox House. Several tastings add up to a meal, with three stops that include a drink, covering Scottish culinary history in a small group. Stops include Edinburgh New Town, Edinburgh Old Town, John Knox House. Dietary needs are requested 48 hours ahead so the kitchen stops can adjust. The route mixes Georgian New Town rooms with Old Town closes rather than a single restaurant booking. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided tasting walk instead of assembling reservations alone.

highlights: Food and drink tour of Edinburgh's Old and New Towns
Includes food and drinks tastings that equate to a meal
Learn all about Scotland's history and food culture
A small group ensures a more personalized experience
